Chapter 305: Chapter 9: Net Worth Skyrockets (Please Subscribe)_2

This would be hundreds to thousands of times more difficult than cultivating to the Eighth Layer.

…

“Space Rules…”

Lin Yuan continued to comprehend the Space Rules.

It must be said that the spatial fluctuations on the Battlefields of Different Races

greatly reduced the difficulty for Lin Yuan to comprehend the Space Rules.

...

Simply put,

if it were on Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of Space Rules would be like someone with 800-degree nearsightedness trying to view the scenery.

Then on the Battlefields of Different Races, Lin Yuan’s vision in degrees would drop to 700, 600.

It would visibly become clearer.

“Hmm?”

“Has the Yang Spirit already entered the Chikun Star Domain?”

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed as he looked in a certain direction.

Whether it was the Yin Spirit or Yang Spirit, both were parts of Lin Yuan’s soul; even if separated by vast distances, he could still sense their locations.

“The Yin Spirit has also entered the Battlefields of Different Races…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

To avoid wasting time comprehending the Space Rules,

Lin Yuan had the Yin Spirit go to the Battlefields of Different Races before the Yang Spirit brought back the legacy of the Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin.

Thus, although still wasting some time, it was much better than having the Yang Spirit travel back and forth.

After all,

since the original Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit share the same consciousness, no matter who was on the Battlefields of Different Races, Lin Yuan could synchronize perspectives, making no difference.

…

After finishing his cultivation,

Lin Yuan connected to the Virtual World and arrived at the Canglan Star Virtual World.

“Xiaoyuan.”

His mother, Lu Qiong, saw Lin Yuan and immediately smiled in greeting.

“Mm…”

Lin Yuan nodded.

His father Lin Shoucheng was also nearby,

chiming in with a few words from time to time.

“You really don’t plan to come to the main star?”

Lin Yuan asked again for confirmation.

Since Lin Yuan had revealed his identity and was infused into the Thirteen Peaks of the Chikun Main Star,

he had asked his parents if they would like to move to Chikun Main Star.

After all, from any perspective, Chikun Main Star absolutely surpassed Canglan Star.

One was an ordinary Middle-grade Life Planet, while the other was the most prosperous and thriving main star of a star domain; there was no comparison at all.

And for his parents moving to the Chikun Main Star, there was no scenario of starting from scratch, where they had high status on Canglan Star but fell greatly upon moving to the main star.

Merely with the identities of parents of the Thirteen Peaks Master, Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong, even on Chikun Main Star, would be highly respected, even by the Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warriors.

“Xiaoyuan.”

“Let it be.”

“We’ve been on Canglan Star since we were young, and we’re used to it…”

Lin Shoucheng said with a smile, “Although Canglan Star is backward, it’s our home planet. Now being able to live in the most upscale manor in the Central Mainland, your mother and I are very satisfied.”

“Yes, Xiaoyuan, go about your own affairs, don’t let us hold you back.”

Lu Qiong added from the side.

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan fell silent for a moment and did not press further.

His parents were the type of people who preferred to live in peace in a corner.

Canglan Star had everything they were familiar with, a Sun, twelve planets, and so on, to which they were already accustomed.

“That’s fine.”

“If you have any issues, just speak to Hou Ming,”

Lin Yuan said after a thought.

Hou Ming was indeed Lin Yuan’s Captain of the Guard Troops, a Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warrior.

When Lin Yuan went to Chikun Main Star, he specifically left Hou Ming behind.

In addition, the Guard Troops of the Dawn Association’s president were also protecting his parents.

It could be said that the current security forces for his parents were very sufficient, even surpassing that of the Canglan Star Governor.

“Xiaoyuan, don’t worry too much, we have the Virtual World. If we want to see you, we can at any time,”

Lu Qiong continued.

“Right.”

Lin Shoucheng nodded.

With the Virtual World, many things became simple; even if separated by dozens of Star Domains, meeting wasn’t difficult.

…

After chatting with his parents for a while, Lin Yuan exited the virtual world.

“I’m back.”

Lin Yuan stepped out of the great hall.

At this moment, a pitch-black spacecraft was slowly descending.

Whoosh.

Streams of the Power of Taiyang.

Silently appeared and finally merged into Lin Yuan’s body.

It was Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit.

This time, sending the Taiyang Divine Spirit to the Battlefields of Different Races,

The greatest gain was not the enhanced perception of the spatial model.

But acquiring the entire legacy of an Eighth Layer Evolutionist.

Returning to the great hall.

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly.

A silver-white bracelet appeared.

This silver-white bracelet, primitive in design, differed in aesthetic from the current human civilization’s space equipment.

It was indeed the storage bracelet of the Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin.

“Although I am one of the Thirteen Peaks Masters of the Red Kun Lineage, exalted in status, I didn’t possess much wealth,”

“Now, that has been rectified.”

Lin Yuan’s spirit was pleased; even as a disciple of the Chikun Star Lord, he could not just magically receive an abundance of treasures and riches, at most some life-saving items.

Previously, Heiyu Mo was planning to lure Lin Yuan out with a precious treasure, confident that this Peak Master must be lacking in valuable resources.

This was very normal.

For most Evolvers to acquire a vast wealth, it’s usually through years of accumulation.

As for the revenue division from the Martial Path Evolutionary Path that Lin Yuan established, not much time had passed? This kind of income was more steady rather than a sudden windfall.

“This space bracelet is indeed a rare treasure,”

Lin Yuan closely examined the silver-white bracelet, his expression one of admiration.

Even among spatial storage treasures, there are varying levels; some with minimal internal space, incapable of holding life.

While some spatial storage treasures boast vast and extremely stable spaces, not prone to fluctuations.

This silver-white bracelet was clearly among the latter.

“Eighth Rank armor…”

Lin Yuan quickly refined the silver-white bracelet and pulled out a cyan-colored armor.

This armor, nearly one meter in size, was engraved with mysterious patterns. As soon as Lin Yuan took it out, it floated in the air, faintly emitting a certain profound aura.

“Eighth Rank defensive weapons oh… This is surely a life-saving item….”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face; wearing this Eighth Rank armor, he could withstand all physical attacks below the Eighth Layer. As for attacks at the Eighth Layer level, it could weaken most of them.

From this, it can be seen that what Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin valued the most was defense, preserving life.

After all, from the legacy he left behind, no Eighth Rank offensive treasures were found; they might have been lost.

“This armor could be kept for personal use, or sold…”

Eighth Rank armor is not limited to being worn only by Eighth Rank Evolvers,

Seventh Rank, Sixth Rank could wear it too, but only Eighth Rank Evolvers could fully unlock the defensive capabilities of the Eighth Rank armor.

“Some Seventh Rank, Sixth Rank weapons…”

Lin Yuan once again took out seven or eight weapons from the silver-white bracelet.

These weapons must have been occasionally obtained by Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin.

“And a thousand Cubic Universe Crystals…”

Lin Yuan flipped his hand and took out a Cubic Universe Crystal, a fist-sized crystal jade, with incredibly pure cosmic energy flowing inside.

“A Cubic Universe Crystal is equivalent to one hundred million universe coins, equivalent to a trillion human civilization coins…”

Lin Yuan was astounded.

Civilization coins are just the internal trading currency of human civilization.

Seventh and Eighth Layer Evolvers mostly use universe coins for transactions, and not limited to within the human race.

Therefore—

Universe coins are the ‘hard currency’ accepted for transactions by the Ten Thousand Universe Races.

The reason being that universe coins contain extremely high-grade cosmic energy.

This quality of cosmic energy can meet the consumptive needs of the Seventh Rank, Eighth Rank or even stronger beings in combat; relying on slowly absorbing cosmic energy to recover?

Too slow, the enemy will not foolishly wait for your recovery.

Extracting the energy inside a universe coin is much more convenient, precisely because universe coins have an irreplaceable role for higher-rank strong ones, they became a universally accepted trading currency among many races.

Because the universe coins themselves possess extremely high value.

“Much purer than the energy in Red Spirit Fluid…”

Lin Yuan compared inwardly, then focused his attention on the last treasure within the silver-white bracelet.

This treasure was the most valuable of all the treasures; even if the Eighth Rank armor, Seventh Rank and Sixth Rank weapons, a thousand Cubic Universe Crystals were combined,

They still couldn’t match up to this treasure.
